claim: Per-layer attention census of 180 open-weight LLM releases, 2025 to 13 November 2026, read from each model's config.json
method: One row per release. Every token-mixing layer is classified from config.json (or the repo's modeling code where the config only gives a rule): F full softmax attention over every earlier token (MHA, GQA, MQA, MLA, CCA); S sliding-window or chunked; L linear or recurrent state (Gated DeltaNet, KDA, RDA, Mamba-2, lightning, mLSTM); C short convolution; P index-selected sparse attention (DSA, MSA, QSA, LSA, CSA); H heavily compressed attention (DeepSeek HCA). class is all-full, hybrid (some F) or no-full (no F); sparse and compressed layers count as not full. pattern is the layer order, null where the config gives only a group size. derivativeOf marks third-party fine-tunes and same-lab re-uploads with an unchanged architecture; the article's own tallies leave those 13 rows out. released is the gallery's date for its 115 rows and the Hugging Face repo creation date for the 65 added rows (Granite 4.2 8B from its README).
source: Hugging Face config.json and modeling files; row list from Sebastian Raschka's LLM Architecture Gallery plus open-weight releases covered on ai.satyajit.si
note: MTP/draft layers, vision encoders and FFN-only blocks are not counted. Two models are classified from the gallery card because their configs are gated (Soofi S, Antares 1B). Six gated originals were read from a public copy, named in the config column: Gemma 3 27B and 270M, Llama 4 Maverick, Muse Spark Open, Command A (quantized re-uploads that keep the config) and Tiny Aya (a third-party fine-tune merge whose layer_types match the gallery card).
